determinism_control.cause: superblock mkfs_time field (offset 8..11) changes with wall clock; padded3 mkfs_time=1793336861 vs 1793336723
determinism_control.lesson_for_the_counter: an image sha256 is NOT a stable identity across builds; pin the mkfs_time field or the bytes_used/file_size pair instead

magic_vs_padding_probe.purpose: does the ddwrt reader refusal come from the missing 4K pad or from the non-standard magic?
magic_vs_padding_probe.mutation: patched ONLY byte 0 (0x74 't' -> 0x73 's'), turning the non-standard magic 0x74717368 ('tqsh') into the standard BE magic 0x73717368 ('sqsh'); length and padding untouched
magic_vs_padding_probe.conclusion: unsquashfs refuses the ddwrt images BECAUSE of the non-standard magic, NOT because of the missing 4K pad: the 4096-byte 4kpad image is refused identically, and a one-byte magic patch makes BOTH the 320-byte nopad and the 4096-byte 4kpad image readable (rc 0). The pad state and the refusal are INDEPENDENT.

lane_fixture_census.note: the R42C1Oracle unblob 26.6.4 squashfs fixture tree (24 padding-variant files) measured in-place, read-only
lane_fixture_census.observation: the three padding variants of every family are the SAME image at 320 / 1024 / 4096 bytes; 'nopad' is the unpadded length and '4kpad' is the 4KiB-padded length. The 1kpad variant is padded to 1024, not 4096.

failed_body_presence_sweep.purpose: is the round-42 failed body Z3_v3ddwrt_inode_table.bin (sha256 839c17a8...) present anywhere in the lane tree?
failed_body_presence_sweep.target_magic_from_lane_envelope: tqsh  (the committed envelope's base64 sasquatch stderr says: Non-standard SquashFS Magic: 'tqsh')
failed_body_presence_sweep.method: magic-anchored 320-byte carve sweep: locate every b'tqsh'/b'hsqt' occurrence in every lane file and sha256 only those 320-byte windows (script probe/carve_sweep.py)
failed_body_presence_sweep.control_meaning: the sweep finds a 320-byte ddwrt-magic window when one IS present, so the negative lane result is a real absence and not a broken filter
failed_body_presence_sweep.superseded_run: an earlier sweep hashing EVERY 320-byte window of every file was killed at its 400 s bound with no output (exit 143); that run was inconclusive and is not claimed as a result
failed_body_presence_sweep.conclusion: the failed body is not in the lane tree; the round-42 scratch /fast/scratch/hyaku/kaidoku-r42 no longer exists

exit_code_semantics.meaning: the probe met its own acceptance (both images built, byte difference and shape measured, readers exercised, discriminator isolated, failed-body presence sweep run with a passing positive control)
